```sql
SELECT batter
FROM (
    SELECT d.batter,
           m.season,
           SUM(d.batter_runs) AS season_runs
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m USING (match_id)
    GROUP BY d.batter, m.season
) AS sr
WHERE sr.season_runs >= 500
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sr.season) >= 3
ORDER BY batter;
```
